title: incident-bot: oncall runbook linking + slo-toolkit diagnostics helpers
author: Priya Shah
description:
Motivation: improve on-call runbook discoverability and SLO diagnostic helpers used by incident-bot and the slo-toolkit. Users reported that runbook links returned by the bot were noisy and lacked context for on-call responders (ENG-3421). This PR adds deterministic runbook linking heuristics, contextual SLO hints from the slo-toolkit, and a small on-call helper library used by the incident-bot UI and alert responders.

Summary of changes: adds a runbook linking utility that ranks runbooks by SLO relevance and recent playbook hits; exposes a compact oncall helper API in incident-bot for rendering quicklinks and suggested remediation steps; adds diagnostic helpers in slo-toolkit to compute contextual SLO hints (error budgets, recent burn rates) for a given alert; updates docs with usage examples and rollouts. Includes unit and integration tests and small telemetry additions (events for link selection).

Testing & rollout: unit tests added for ranking heuristics and SLO hint thresholds; integration test that simulates an alert -> runbook linking flow. Feature is behind config flag INCIDENT_BOT_RUNBOOK_LINKING_ENABLED and rolled out via gradual opt-in for oncall teams.

Related: ENG-3478 (oncall UX follow-ups).

review_comments: Ethan Liu: Can we add a short-circuit for low-confidence matches? I saw a case where the top link had low overlap and was confusing. Also please add telemetry for why a link was chosen (rule_id/confidence).

Priya Shah: Added short-circuit logic and telemetry. See new unit tests that assert low-confidence returns no link when confidence < 0.25. Telemetry event incident_bot.runbook.choice includes rule_id and confidence.
Marina Gomez: Tests look good; one nit about magic numbers in diagnostics.py (use constants). Also we should avoid a synchronous call to catalog lookup in the main request path.
Priya Shah: Reworked catalog lookup to be async/cached and replaced magic numbers with named constants. PTAL.
Riley Chen: Approved after resolving flakiness in the integration test by adding deterministic timestamps and a mock store. CI green on the latest run.
ci_summary: Initial CI: lint failed (unused import) -> fixed. Unit tests: one flaky test failed on first run (integration: runbook selection flake) -> added deterministic timestamp -> rerun passed. Full CI green (lint, unit, integration, e2e smoke).
release_notes:
- incident-bot: improved runbook linking with SLO-aware ranking and quicklinks for on-call responders.
- slo-toolkit: diagnostic helpers to compute burn rate and remaining error budget for contextual hints.
- docs: runbooks/oncall.md added with configuration and rollout guidance.
notes_for_oncall: Behavior behind flag INCIDENT_BOT_RUNBOOK_LINKING_ENABLED. If you see missing links for alerts, toggle the flag to false to revert to legacy behavior while we investigate. Telemetry events: incident_bot.runbook.choice and slo_toolkit.diagnostics.hint produced for each selection.
additional_context: This is part of the larger oncall improvements initiative. Follow-up tasks: tune ranking weights based on production telemetry, add per-team override lists, and expose link feedback (thumbs up/down) to improve ranking signals.
